# Quality control 
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)

meta <- read_excel(here("data/final_metadata_uniqueID_new.xlsx")) %>%
  filter(Clock =="multitissue")


meth_raw <- best_model_list[["Multi_organ"]][["methylation_data"]]

# --- 1) Identify sample columns (exclude annotation columns) ---
annot_cols <- c("chr", "start", "end", "strand", "Probe")
sample_cols <- setdiff(colnames(meth_raw), intersect(colnames(meth_raw), annot_cols))

# Keep only columns that exist in metadata IDs
sample_cols <- intersect(sample_cols, meta$Sanger_new_ID)

stopifnot(length(sample_cols) > 2)

# Subset methylation matrix (features x samples)
meth_mat <- as.matrix(meth_raw[, sample_cols, drop = FALSE])

# --- 2) Align metadata to methylation columns ---
meta2 <- meta[match(colnames(meth_mat), meta$Sanger_new_ID), ]
stopifnot(all(meta2$Sanger_new_ID == colnames(meth_mat)))

# Ensure batch is a factor
meta2$batch <- as.factor(meta2$sequencing_block)

# --- 3) Handle missing values (PCA cannot take NA) ---
# Mean impute per CpG/feature (row-wise)
na_idx <- is.na(meth_mat)
if (any(na_idx)) {
  row_means <- rowMeans(meth_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  meth_mat[na_idx] <- row_means[row(na_idx)][na_idx]
}

# --- 4) PCA ---
pca <- prcomp(t(meth_mat), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
var_exp <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)

pca_df <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(meth_mat),
  PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
  batch = meta2$batch
)

# If you have other covariates you want to show:
# pca_df$age <- meta2$age
# pca_df$tissue <- meta2$tissue

# --- 5) Plot PCA coloured by batch ---
library(ggplot2)

p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = batch)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of methylation profiles",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * var_exp[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_pca)

# --- 6) Batch statistic: does batch explain PC1/PC2? (effect size + p) ---
m1 <- summary(lm(PC1 ~ batch, data = pca_df))
m2 <- summary(lm(PC2 ~ batch, data = pca_df))

cat("\nBatch ~ PC1: R^2 =", signif(m1$r.squared, 3),
    " | p =", signif(pf(m1$fstatistic[1], m1$fstatistic[2], m1$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE), 3), "\n")

cat("Batch ~ PC2: R^2 =", signif(m2$r.squared, 3),
    " | p =", signif(pf(m2$fstatistic[1], m2$fstatistic[2], m2$fstatistic[3], lower.tail = FALSE), 3), "\n")

```

# Loading in matrixes from all models 
```{r f}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(lme4)
library(broom)
library(glmnet)
library(purrr)
  library(here)
})

output_directory <- here("results/Graphs")
dir.create(output_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)



cpg_data<- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_cpg_final.csv"))

metrics_data <- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_metrics_final.csv"))

predicted_data <- read.csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/final_merged/results_predicted_final.csv"))

## -------- Define fuctions ---------- ##
clean_up_data <- function(df) {
  df %>% 
    filter(dataset == "Validation") %>%
    filter(!model %in% c("old_elastic_net", "old_lasso")) %>%  # remove old models  in case sill present 
    dplyr::mutate(
      rsq_threshold = dplyr::recode(
        rsq_threshold,
        "nofilter" = "r2_nofilter",
        "0.05" = "r2_0.05",
        "0.1"  = "r2_0.1",
        "0.2"  = "r2_0.2",
        "0.3"  = "r2_0.3"
      ),
      rsq_threshold = factor(
        rsq_threshold,
        levels = c("r2_nofilter","r2_0.05","r2_0.1","r2_0.2","r2_0.3")
      ),
      filter = factor(
        filter,
        levels = c("nofilter","min5", "min10", "min20")
      ),
      unique_model_id = paste(cpg_grouping,model_id, sep = "_")
    )  %>%
  mutate(
    organ = case_when(
      organ == "Fin_clip_caudal" ~"Caudal_Fin" ,
      organ == "All_organs"~"Multi_organ"  ,
     TRUE ~ organ
    )
  )


}

get_shapes <- function(n) {
  # valid ggplot shapes: 0–25 
  # choose a clean subset
  shapes <- c(0:14)   # 15 visually distinct shapes
  
  if (n > length(shapes)) {
    stop("Need more shapes than available")
  }
  
  shapes[1:n]
}



## ------------- Clean up data 

cpg_data_validation       <- clean_up_data(cpg_data)
metrics_data_validation   <- clean_up_data(metrics_data)
predicted_data_validation <- clean_up_data(predicted_data)


## -- clean up probe column 
cpg_data_validation_long<- cpg_data_validation %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(selected_cpgs, sep = ";") %>% # split cpg list 
  dplyr::mutate(selected_cpgs = trimws(selected_cpgs)) %>% # Ensure no whitespace issues
    mutate(selected_cpgs = gsub("chr","",selected_cpgs))%>%
  separate(selected_cpgs, c("chr","start","end"), remove = F, sep = ":")  %>%# split probe id to get chromosome metadtaa 
  dplyr::mutate(chr = trimws(chr),
                chr = factor(chr, levels = c(1:25)))


colnames(predicted_data_validation) <-
  sub("^data\\.", "", colnames(predicted_data_validation))
```
